name: polish
description: Replaces vague 'looks good' UI feedback with a fixed, repeatable audit: walks a design system, UI, or app screen against 14 categories of proven UI/UX practice — iconography, color, typography, hierarchy, spacing, states, shadows, dark mode, overlays, page patterns, and accessibility — and returns a severity- and effort-scored findings report with a concrete fix for each issue.

interface.shortDescription: Audits a design system or UI against 14 categories of UI/UX best practice
interface.longDescription: Use Polish to review, critique, or professionalize a design system, component library, set of screens, or AI/vibe-coded UI. It walks the design against 14 categories of established UI/UX principle and returns a structured findings report with severity, effort, the principle violated, and a concrete fix for each issue.
